title: Packaging Laws, Packaged Commodities Rules and Novel Packaging Technologies
shortDescription: FSSAI packaging regulations, Legal Metrology rules and modified-atmosphere, active and intelligent packaging.
genZNote: The label, the pack and the law have to agree. FSSAI says what's inside, Legal Metrology says how much — two rulebooks, one packet.

sections.heading: Legal Framework
bullets: FSS (Packaging) Regulations, 2018: materials must be food-grade, comply with BIS standards, specify permitted plastics, print inks and recycling conditions; reuse of containers restricted (e.g. only specified food contact reuse).
FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: mandatory labelling content and font rules.

Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011: name/address of manufacturer/packer/importer, generic name, net quantity, month and year of manufacture or packing, MRP inclusive of all taxes, consumer-care details, and unit sale price for specified items.
Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016 (amended): thickness, EPR; BIS standards for packaging (e.g. for packaged drinking water bottles).
Consumer Protection Act, 2019: penalties for misleading information.

sections.heading: Novel Packaging Technologies
sections.body: Recent developments: sustainable and recyclable mono-materials, smart labels with QR/blockchain traceability, retort pouches, high-barrier PET and active antimicrobials. Regulatory approval and migration testing remain essential.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Packaging laws combine food-safety, labelling and metrology requirements; novel technologies extend shelf life by controlling atmosphere or monitoring condition.
keyFacts: Legal Metrology (PC) Rules, 2011: MRP inclusive of all taxes.
MAP uses gas mixes; active packaging uses scavengers.
